title: Repos config
description: Map of repo full-name (owner/repo) to its role in the pilot

base_branch.description: Branch a fresh agent-hq/<issue> branch is cut from

setup.description: Shell commands run in the worktree before the agent starts, per task id. 'default' applies to any task without its own entry; a task id overrides it. Structured setup belongs here, not in a prompt: it costs no agent requests, fails loudly, and is the same every run. The command may leave notes for the agent at .agent-hq/setup-notes.md.

format.description: Shell commands run in the worktree after a successful agent run and before the work patch is materialized, per task id. Same resolution as setup (task id, else 'default', else none). Only runs when the task writes_code. Use this for repo formatters (e.g. prettier on changed files) so CI lint does not fail the PR for style the agent skipped.

qa.description: Evidence media policy for QA runs against this repo. Defaults when omitted: video=true, screenshots=false, video_max_seconds=120. At least one of video or screenshots must be true after defaults (enforced at config load).

video.description: When true (default), a pass requires live-flow video in the ledger

screenshots.description: When true, optional stills are encouraged; when video is false, screenshots become the required evidence mode

video_max_seconds.description: Soft cap for Playwright recordVideo clips
